instruction_summary.scope: Executed ARM instructions on the prepared finite corpus, with typed 32-bit return masking. When actual_bootrom is present, SDK ROM lookup initializers, wrappers and ROM bodies execute without intrinsic models. SIO division remains functionally modeled. These are not hardware cycles, cache comparisons, timings, or proof of speed parity.

integer_arm.scope: Actual ARM normalized128-bit products, including aliasing squares, are checked against independent exact Fraction products of both operand intervals. Every accepted integer/inverse-power result matches directed MPFR; selected full public calls check integration. Base exponents, full mantissas, both exponent signs, exceptional inputs, declined exponent domains and the saved hard pow fixtures are covered. Finite tests supplement the algebraic certificate; no universal totality or physical-speed claim.

square_arm.scope: Actual ARM square centers lose strictly less than7 retained128-bit units and propagated enclosures contain exact rational endpoint squares. All-bit carry boundaries, maximal words, random full mantissas, zero low words and input radii through65535 are covered. Zero-low cases remain byte-identical to the parent full aliased product, including zero radius for exact sqrt-cube certification. Every call checks ABI and bounded writes. Finite coverage complements the algebraic bound; not universal pow totality or physical timings.

dyadic_arm.scope: Actual production ARM dyadic midpoint decisions checked with independently formed exact rational x^p and midpoint^q, including jittered valid input enclosures. Both exponent signs and denominator powers through128 are covered. Exact, adjacent, distant and invalid hints have no rounding authority; every accepted result matches directed MPFR. Selected full public calls check integration. This is finite coverage, not totality or physical-speed proof.

first_cell_arm.scope: Actual ARM trusted pointer+cell entry with valid adjacent cells, distant binade-start cells and aliasing; every result matches directed MPFR. Hooks at the real public-path callee verify the first-tier two-cell guarantee. Arbitrary untrusted hints are checked separately through the preserved old API. Finite tests do not prove totality or device timings.

generic_M0_isolation.scope: Non-RP2040 generic ARMv6-M: every allocated code/data section remains byte-identical to V60. The generic spelling has an extra expression macro; normalized preprocessing identity is not claimed.

cache_model.assumptions: Same previously checked 16 KiB / two-way / 8-byte-line cache geometry; LRU/FIFO replacement and whole-line/per-word fills are explicit model assumptions. These are not claims about undocumented prefetch or replacement.
cache_model.scope: Exact ARM instruction/data traces and exact results on the recorded finite groups per image, including every ln/log10 stream and the three difficult pow streams, with actual ROM and linked memory code. Two warm passes then a measured third pass. Only XIP accesses enter the cache model. Excludes caller prefetch, IRQs, other-core traffic and Qfplib batches. Not measured XIP counters or physical speed evidence.

patch_reproduction.scope: Fresh application to the six affected parent paths reproduces each final source file byte for byte; the separate source validator covers the 638 other unchanged files. No index or production mutation.
